snippet.title: Pigmentone - Greenlight Trailer
snippet.description:
Pigmentone is a puzzle game where the main control element is color. Ironically, and contrary to its name, uses color temperature.

In his puzzles the colours travelers through multiple receivers, combined or divided, while sharing the color with the rest, but each color has its own place and you must find out where each one goes.

Available on Steam Greenlight™: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=521355063
